text: The book gives the marketing conversion TOPS/W = 2 / E_MAC[pJ]. What energy per MAC corresponds to 20 TOPS/W?
choices: A throughput figure, so no energy per MAC can be defined
explanation: Solving 20 = 2 / E_MAC[pJ] gives E_MAC = 0.1 pJ = 100 fJ/MAC (the factor of 2 because a MAC counts as two operations). Choice 1 (1 pJ) instead corresponds to 2 TOPS/W; choice 2 (10 pJ) to 0.2 TOPS/W; choice 3 misreads the direct relationship between the two metrics.
